en.text:
Base Grenade Cooldown is set to 152 seconds while equipped. 

Holding [Grenade] summons a frontal <void/>Void Shield that grants <pve 95% /> <pvp [75%?] /> Damage Resistance against blocked shots. Combatants in front of you are taunted, and enemies that contact the shield become Disoriented. 

<void/>Void Shield drains 50% your Grenade Energy over 1 second, then 25% per second after that, in exchange for continuously granting you ? HP <void/>Void Overshield every second. Void Overshield lasts for 5 seconds (7.5 with <void/>Echo of Persistence).

Blocking damage reduces your movement speed by 50% for 0.5 seconds and grants ?% Grenade Energy per hit absorbed. Energy granted is reduced over time. If you have <void/>Sentinel Shield equipped, blocking damage also spawns an Orb of Power for your allies every 4.5 seconds.

Releasing [Grenade] unleashes a blast of <void/>Void Energy 11? meters in front of you, consuming your Grenade Charge and dealing damage proportional to the amount of damage you blocked. 

Kill with this blast grant <void/>Devour for ? seconds (? with <void/>Echo of Persistence).
